mapper.select: WITH minute_stats AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, closing_price AS market_price FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = 1 ORDER BY token_id, created_at DESC ), daily_stats AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, trade_volume AS daily_trade_volume FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = 1440 ORDER BY token_id, created_at DESC ) SELECT t.token_id AS token_id, t.token_name AS token_name, t.ticker_symbol AS ticker_symbol, COALESCE(ms.market_price, 0) AS market_price, COALESCE(ds.daily_trade_volume, 0) AS daily_trade_volume FROM tokens t LEFT JOIN minute_stats ms ON t.token_id = ms.token_id LEFT JOIN daily_stats ds ON t.token_id = ds.token_id ORDER BY ds.daily_trade_volume DESC NULLS LAST

WITH minute_stats AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, closing_price AS market_price FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = '1m'::quote_unit_enum ORDER BY token_id, created_at DESC ), daily_stats AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, trade_volume AS daily_trade_volume FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = '1d'::quote_unit_enum ORDER BY token_id, created_at DESC ) SELECT t.token_id AS token_id, t.token_name AS token_name, t.ticker_symbol AS ticker_symbol, COALESCE(ms.market_price, 0) AS market_price, COALESCE(ds.daily_trade_volume, 0) AS daily_trade_volume FROM tokens t LEFT JOIN minute_stats ms ON t.token_id = ms.token_id LEFT JOIN daily_stats ds ON t.token_id = ds.token_id
(t.token_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%') OR t.ticker_symbol ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%'))
ORDER BY ds.daily_trade_volume DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT order_id, order_side, order_price, order_volume, remaining_token, created_at FROM orders WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND token_id = #{tokenId} AND order_type = 'LIMIT'::order_type_enum AND remaining_token > 0 AND order_state IN ('NEW'::order_state_enum, 'PARTIAL'::order_state_enum) ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT closing_price FROM token_quotes WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ts.asset_type = 'CASH'::asset_type_enum THEN ts.amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN ts.asset_type = 'TOKEN'::asset_type_enum THEN ts.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS price, MAX(CASE WHEN ts.asset_type = 'TOKEN'::asset_type_enum THEN ts.amount END) AS volume, ( SELECT o2.order_side FROM transaction_hists ts2 JOIN orders o2 ON ts2.order_id = o2.order_id WHERE ts2.trade_id = ts.trade_id ORDER BY o2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS takerSide, MAX(ts.created_at) AS createdAt FROM transaction_hists ts JOIN orders o ON ts.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.token_id = #{tokenId} AND ts.transaction_type = 'TRADE'::transaction_type_enum GROUP BY ts.trade_id ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT token_id, (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM candle_time))::BIGINT AS candleTime, opening_price, high_price , low_price, closing_price, trade_volume FROM token_quotes WHERE token_id = #{tokenId} AND unit = 1 ORDER BY candle_time LIMIT #{limit}
